monologue.b1: Sovereign Agent Fleet is two things wired into one core: a live prediction-market exchange, and a governability layer that refuses to trust any model. Today the exchange is the star.
monologue.b2: Here's the live Kalshi Market Ticker. One authenticated websocket, subscribed to ALL markets. In the eight seconds before I cut this frame it received over four thousand real price ticks across more than two thousand distinct markets.
monologue.b3: Every tick is parsed and republished with an honest flag: live equals true. Nobody fakes liveness here. The stream connects, counts, and if it ever drops, liveness just goes dark rather than inventing numbers.
monologue.b4: The same endpoint, sim-only mode. Same code path, no credentials. The status block reports connected false, live false, zero ticks, with a note explaining exactly why. Honesty is the default, not the demo.
monologue.b5: And here's the governability half that makes this safe. The fleet policy takes verification, severity, and asset class, and returns one of three decisions: auto, human, or blocked. A hallucinated claim is blocked at every tier. Revenue-critical always escalates to a human. Identity never gets contained.
monologue.b6: That's the whole point. A live market feed the model can read, behind gates the model can never bypass. Exchange runs hot; the governance refuses by design. Built real, verified live, and owned by you.
